model_solution:
المعادلات:
NH3(aq) + H2O(l) ⇌ NH4+(aq) + OH-(aq)
NH4Cl(s) → NH4+(aq) + Cl-(aq)
حساب pOH:
pH + pOH = 14
9 + pOH = 14
pOH = 14 - 9 = 5
القانون والتعويض:
pOH = pKb + log([salt] / [base])
5 = 4.74 + log([salt] / 0.1)
5 - 4.74 = log([salt] / 0.1)
0.26 = log([salt] / 0.1)
إيجاد قيمة الملح:
log(1.82) = log([salt] / 0.1)
1.82 = [salt] / 0.1
[salt] = 1.82 × 0.1 = 0.182 M

المعادلات:
NH3(aq) + H2O(aq) ⇌ NH4+(aq) + OH-(aq)
NH4Cl(s) → NH4+(aq) + Cl-(aq)
تنبيه:
[salt]/[base] = [NH4+]/[NH3]
حساب pOH:
pH + pOH = 14
9 + pOH = 14
pH = 14 - 9
pOH = 5
القانون والتعويض:
pOH = pKb + log([NH4+] / [NH3])
5 = 4.74 + log([NH4+] / [NH3])
5 - 4.74 = log([NH4+] / [NH3])
0.26 = log([NH4+] / [NH3])
إيجاد النسبة:
log1.8 = log([NH4+] / [NH3])
[NH4+] / [NH3] = 1.8
